steps.name: Yuran's Call
steps.objective: Go to [Yuran] at the “Luman Coalition Headquarters”.

steps.name: Sandstorm in the Amalun Desert
steps.objective: Defeat [Nakba of the Desert] in “Amalun Desert” and report to [Yuran].

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: You are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Iris? I think Wool showed up and took Iris with him... . What on earth is going on?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'll talk about that later. I'll just convey what I have to say.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: We are protecting Iris, but... ..

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I believe that our union also bears some responsibility for what happens due to incomplete awakening.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: So, we are sorting out what happened in the Forest of Water Lily. Iris I will talk about this later, so please wait a moment... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If only for a little while... I'm avoiding talking...)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Not long ago, a huge sandstorm blew from the Amalun Desert, west of the Judean Kingdom.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's the problem?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I'm saying this because it's not a normal sandstorm. A huge sandstorm filled with magical power transformed the Amalun Desert.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How has the desert changed?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Originally, the Amalun Desert was so barren that it was called the ‘Desert of Nothingness’, making it uninhabitable for life.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: So, it is a place where people, animals, and monsters do not even approach.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: In that place, a sandstorm full of magical power came and went, and strange castles and buildings that could not be said to belong to Eastland appeared... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: People and strange life appeared within it. Existence from another world... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: And… , no.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why drink while talking?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I don't think I need to say anything because it's something minor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think there's something there, I'll have to find out later.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes, please hurry.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: (Yu-ran stares at the back of %s leaving the Luman Alliance Headquarters.)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There were more monsters than I thought.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: %s It is understandable that the guild agents who went to the desert before you came back as if they were being chased.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Situations like this continue to increase.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There is a bone in words….)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Because it's true.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There is no need to be so surprised. Surprisingly, it is easy to recognize %s from his facial expression.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Oh, one of the guild agents who had just been to the desert woke up and talked to me.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: It is said that there was an oasis in the center of the desert that had never existed before, and that they found a woman wearing clothes from another world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of person are you?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I was chased by monsters that appeared in the desert and I didn't know until then. I think Adventurer should know... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… , I see. Actually, I didn't have high expectations... .

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Our union basically has a lot of work to do. From helping to restore the nearby kingdom of Jude, you also have to deal with the Deimos Church, which sows evil... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You want to lend me a hand.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: This is a formal request from the Federation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: The Jewel School wizards were asked to set up a defensive barrier on the way into the Jude Kingdom and Lumen for safety.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: So, you can come after solving the problem in the Amalun Desert outside the barrier.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do I have to solve it all on my own?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Yes, I think %s is the right person. It's only natural that the people who help Iris do Iris's work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's not wrong, but isn't it too much for me to do alone?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: If you go all the way west, you will reach the underground city of Tartarus, but you don't have to go there.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Then please ask again this time. If possible, I would like you to finish everything and come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have no choice but to go first.)

steps.name: First desert survey
steps.objective: Defeat [Sandstorm Fighter] and [Ra's Guard] in "Amalun Desert" and report to [Tiya].

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I've been waiting for you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean? This is my first time seeing you... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Don't panic. I'm not a bad person.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Let me introduce myself. My name is Tiya. She is the daughter of the pharaoh who owned the golden castle you see over there.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: There is no need to be cautious. I am not the enemy. Rather, I would like to ask for help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't feel any hostility, but... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: So can you trust me if I do this? I'll give you this, something that doesn't exist in your world.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: (Tiya hands over a gold ornament.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it okay if I give you something like this?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: How about something like this? If you listen to my story, I can give you more of what you need... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll believe it. So keep what I wanted to give you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tiya returns the gold ornament she was holding in her hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. The reason I came here... … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Briefly explain to Tiya why you came here.)

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I will also tell you how I came here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: After their father, the previous pharaoh, died, the brothers fought each other to ascend to the throne.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: My younger brother and I, who were the weakest and least powerful, just wanted these hellish days to end... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: My older brother and sisters didn't do that. They probably thought they were a burden and tried to kill them all.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: In the process, my younger brother became disillusioned with everyone and ended up doing things he should never have done.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: A contract with the god of the dead. The younger brother, controlled by the power of darkness, kills all his brothers... . I couldn't bear to kill him, so I gave him time to run away.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: The next day, the child made himself king. I haven't seen my brother since. It would be nice if that was all... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: The dark power of the god of the dead began to cover the country.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something like that happened. Oh, wait a minute.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I want to hear more about your story... . Monsters nearby are interfering. I'll take care of it soon.

steps.name: Desert investigation second
steps.objective: Defeat the [Priestess of Fear] in “Amalun Desert” and report to [Tiya].

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then shall we continue what we were talking about?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes. After that, I was outside the castle looking for a way to bring my brother back and save my country.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: To my shame, I haven't found a way yet.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: But one day, a strong sandstorm filled with magical power suddenly struck our kingdom... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's why you came here.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: A bigger problem arose when I came here. Darkness spreads across this continent. An evil more cruel than anything else... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: As I enter the castle, I keep trying to build something bigger... . help… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As for the darkness on this continent... . When I heard those words, I felt it clearly. The ominous energy here... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: If you check the monsters nearby, you might know something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you find out anything, can you please take a look? Because I don’t have any knowledge about where Tiya lived.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Of course I have to let you know. thank you. Please take care of yourself.

steps.name: convey the situation
steps.objective: After talking with Tiya in “Amalun Desert”, report to [Yuran] at “Ruman Coalition Headquarters”.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Welcome, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Tiya the story of fighting all life with Ra in the desert kingdom.)

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I think the power of the god of the dead and the power of darkness flowing through this continent influenced each other and grew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If we were influenced by each other... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Probably a similar force.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is the god of the dead?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: He is a devil-like being, not a god, who engulfed my younger brother with dark power.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: In the desert kingdom of Ra, it is believed that when a person dies, the soul escapes and wanders around looking for a place to go.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: There is someone who takes the soul to the world of the dead so that it does not suffer, and he is the god of the dead.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Guiding people's souls so they don't get lost and helping them find rest... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why do they call him the devil and not God?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: One day, a man who called himself the ‘God of the Dead’ appeared, and as he appeared, the spirit of death hovered in the castle.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: As the Golden Castle gradually lost its shine and people died, Pharaoh found its existence and fought and won.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: He then sealed it in the Guardian Statue and executed the person who summoned it. So that the devil will never appear again... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: However, things took a turn for the worst when my younger brother called upon the sealed god of the dead and made a contract.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: The God of the Dead achieved his goal and temporarily disappeared... . The problem came after that. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Adventurer, I think you should tell this story. Adventurer I think you can prepare to some extent for the magical power of the place you stayed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Please… .

steps.name: Bug monster from another world
steps.objective: Defeat [Ranatun] in "Ra's Castle" and report to [Tiya] in <Amalun Desert>.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Since you came to me, it looks like there is serious content.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Yuran about meeting Tiya in the Amalun Desert.)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I have some understanding of the situation. My whole head hurts. I think we need to address this first where the boundaries are weak.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is it?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Hmm, it’s a place called Ra’s Castle… . Adventurer, do you like bugs?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A bug?

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: They say there's a giant bug monster there. They say they are eating everything they see, but it looks like they will come out at this rate.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: Even if several guild members rush in, it seems like their strength is too much.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: There is no choice but Adventurer will have to solve this problem himself. Only then will it be possible to attack other places... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s for Iris, so I’ll refer to it first, but….)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: I understand you are coming. Please cooperate with the woman from that other world as much as possible to resolve this issue as quickly as possible. And don't worry about Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. We'll talk later.

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: (Yu-ran stares at the back of %s leaving Luman.)

lines.speaker: 유란
lines.text: That won't work either. Something similar must have happened somewhere else, including the Amalun Desert, so I'll have to keep looking into it.

steps.name: The king who made a contract with the god of the dead
steps.objective: Defeat [Matu] in the “Hall of Rest” and report to [Tiya] in <Amalun Desert>.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Thank you. When Lananatun fell, some of the darkness of the 'God of the Dead' in the castle disappeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think some of the bad feeling I had in the desert has disappeared.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: La Na Na Tun has long been an object of fear for the residents of Ra. It had a strong appetite and swallowed people and animals whole.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: As if that wasn't enough, the first Pharaoh was very worried as he came down to the private house from time to time. I tried subduing La Na Na Tun, but it wasn't perfect.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: So, they temporarily suppressed their gluttony by sacrificing heinous sinners to the nest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You shouldn't do anything bad. A life that ends with being eaten by bugs... , it's scary to even think about it.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Adventurer… . Now there's just one thing left... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: My younger brother is no longer the kind and innocent being he used to be. Eaten by the darkness, I became a monster obsessed only with destruction and power.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Adventurer, please do not think of Matu as my younger brother, but as a monster threatening this world. Please.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: (Tiya turns her head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me ask you again. Would you mind?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes, it's okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then… , I will come back.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Seeing as Adventurer is back, it must be over.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Thank you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tiya, it’s okay… ?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. I think my younger brother would also admit his mistake. For taking my younger brother out of the darkness... , thank you.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I no longer feel darkness in the Amalun Desert. It's all thanks to Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I'm trying to go back. I am the only royal left for the residents of Ra, so I must be of strength to them.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I have no shame. Because they are incompetent royals who can only say things like this... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: But, I don't know how to go back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm. Since we rode the sandstorm, are we going to ride it again?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Although that probably makes the most sense.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Wouldn't a skilled wizard know how? I'm sure he's aware of the sandstorm that blew here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I guess so! The wizards of Lumen have checked the sandstorm here, so they might know something! I'll ask and come back!

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Then I'll ask you a favor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back soon. Stay here and wait.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Hello! You look busy. What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It talks about what happened in the Amalun Desert and about a huge sandstorm.)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Sandstorm in the Amalun Desert... . Ugh, what should I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why? Did anything go wrong?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: It's not wrong, but I don't think sandstorms will appear in the desert for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? why?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: That's actually... . The dark power of other worlds, the awakening of the imperfect Iris, and the ominous power of the continent, and so on.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: The magical sandstorm blowing was the result of a combination of several factors.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm asking just in case, did Iris's incomplete awakening affect other worlds as well?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Yes, I think it has some effect, even if it is not big.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's what God is like... .

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I'm talking about a sandstorm. Adventurer eliminated the dark power of the other world, but it is very vague.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: The sandstorm is not blowing. It's not that anyone is blocking it, it seems that the phenomenon itself has ended.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Iris If you become a great god, you will be able to do it quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Iris the only answer…? .

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I think this task will be difficult not only for superhumans but also for Ixion, the heroic archmage who protected the Kingdom of Jude during the Dark War a long time ago.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Even if our skilled jewelers craft all the best magical jewels, they cannot produce that much power... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's hard for even superhumans... . Phew… . But where is Ixion now?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Since he is a person from several hundred years ago, he is probably in a good place, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… . Then I guess I can't help it. I have no choice but to trust Iris and wait. But you can't say anything to Iris.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Yes, that's right. By the way, %s, have you ever lost your memory even for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Eh? no. I've never had anything like that... . why?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I saw someone who lost some of his memory due to the effects of magic, and %s's expression sometimes looked similar. If not, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's probably because of my mood. I'm fine. Then I will tell that to the princess of this world.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Okay, see you later.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Are you here? What did you say I should do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Asma relays the story to Tiya.)

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Oh, is that so? The god that Adventurer serves is in an uneasy state.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I guess you'll have to stay here for a while... , would you mind?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine. You gave me a clear answer that I can go back someday, so that's enough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I think the God that Adventurer serves is a very good person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, what do you mean? Is it Iris? Should I say it’s good? Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Iris, what a beautiful name. Hehehe. And even as you say it, I can feel that you care about it.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Thank you. Thank you for letting me get to know such a great person like Adventurer... .

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: I will take care of this place from now on and make sure it does not cause any damage to nearby kingdoms or villages. I will fulfill my responsibilities as the royal family of Ra to the end.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, sometimes I will come to see Tiya too.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Then please be careful. See you later.

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: (Tiya watches %s's appearance until he disappears and sees him off.)

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: What is this ominous thing... ?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Is there such a thing as a god of the dead in this world? I have no choice but to do something like that... ?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: The princess has a good sense of humor. It's not a god who deals with death, but maybe it's a little similar?

lines.speaker: 티야
lines.text: Wait, you… . Where did it come from... ?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hey, princess? Don't tremble, don't be afraid. Because I have no intention of harming you.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I just want to ask something.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Do you know about ‘▒▒▒▒’?
